focal.name: Yrsa Greypelt
focal.who: A wolfman tracker who trusts no bargain.
focal.backstory: Yrsa Greypelt was nine when her father sold her to a caravan master to settle a gambling debt. She escaped two winters later and never found out why he did it, or where he went.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
